# A review that does not create new tasks

Read the year's notes and made a list of decisions that can stay closed. The habit of extracting an action from every page makes completion impossible. [[Maintenance]] is not a demand that every past interest remain active. Keep one uncertain question for January and leave the rest as a record of what mattered when it was written.
